plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into poison and dexterity scaling
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade damage to kill the body quickly. Enter healthy and reserve burst block or an intangible potion for the next-turn explosion.
plan.summary: Visit an early shop. Prioritize efficient damage, AoE and scaling, then premium defense and draw. Remove basics only after replacements; Greed is permanent. Take elites with damage and potion support.

plan.archetype: Discard-enabled attacks, shiv scaling, and potion-supported defense
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Alchemize and damage. Establish reliable shiv output and stronger block; enter healthy with burst block or intangible protection for the explosion after body death.
plan.summary: Heal immediately, then upgrade Alchemize or damage when safe. Support Accuracy with shiv generation, add dexterity and premium block, and replace basics before removing them. Delay elites and stock explosion protection; current boss damage remains inadequate.
